newsitem.title: USA: Lakehead Pipe Line Q1 net per unit rises.
newsitem.headline: Lakehead Pipe Line Q1 net per unit rises.

text.p: Lakehead Pipe Line Partners LP said Tuesday its operating revenue increased in the first quarter, helping its earnings per unit climb.
The partnership, which owns the U.S. part of the world's longest liquid petroleum pipeline, reported net income of $17.7 million, or $0.71 a unit, in the period ended March 31.

Lakehead reported a loss of $6.3 million a year ago, including provisions for rate refunds of $20.1 million and interest of $3.2 million that reflected retroactive aspects of the 1996 tariff pact between the partnership and customer representatives.
Without the provisions, recalculated net income a year ago totaled $16.8 million, or $0.68 per unit, Lakehead said.
The company said operating income rose to $25.7 million from $5.2 million because of a greater proportion of heavy crude oil deliveries.
Lakehead shares were unchanged Tuesday at 35-1/4.
